# Bundled text fallback
Noto Sans CJK JP Regular, from https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/blob/main/Sans/OTF/Japanese/NotoSansCJKjp-Regular.otf
SIL Open Font License 1.1; see LICENSE. Unmodified font, staged beside the executable in fonts/.
SHA256: `68a3fc98800b2a27b371f2fb79991daf3633bd89309d4ffaa6946fd587f375b5`.
This is the shared font for the retained dynamic text API, not a replacement for image-based game UI.
Original Windows face names fall back to this font; GDI-identical metrics are not claimed.
